snippet.title: Appa - Playtest Trailer | Galaxies Autumn 2026 Showcase
snippet.description:
Find this game and every game from Galaxies Spring on our Steam Event page - https://store.steampowered.com/news/group/45348822/view/719040453611095010

Appa is a narrative card battler about grief, memory and family, with prediction-based combat, manga-style cinematics, and a mix of pixel art and impressionism. It was made by animator and filmmaker Mridul Pancholi at Heat Death Studio, and it's coming to Steam, GOG, itch, the Microsoft Store and Xbox
